name: Smoky Tempeh Fajitas with Peppers, Onions & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Place oil and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp chili powder
2 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp oregano, dried
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice paste, gently stir to coat, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 green bell peppers
2 yellow bell peppers
1 lime
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the tempeh.

Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl and gently stir once more to combine. Transfer tempeh and veggies to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tempeh is browned and veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges. Set aside for serving.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with tempeh, veggies, and avocado. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
